# weft_instance (Resource)

Provisions and manages a VM via weft.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weft_instance" "debian" {
  name = "web-01"
  cpu  = 2
  mem  = 2

  disk {
    from = "https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/latest/debian-13-genericcloud-arm64.raw"
    size = "20Gi"

    # Optional: per-instance disk patches applied before first boot.
    patch {
      add {
        content = "weft.local\n"
        dst     = "/etc/hostname"
      }
      mod {
        dst = "/etc/default/grub"
        old = "GRUB_TIMEOUT=5"
        new = "GRUB_TIMEOUT=0"
      }
    }
  }

  ssh {
    user         = "debian"
    keypair_path = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
  }
}

output "instance_ip" {
  value = weft_instance.debian.ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique VM name.

### Optional

- `cpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs (default 2).
- `disk` (Block, Optional) Boot disk configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--disk))
- `mem` (Number) Memory in GiB (default 2).
- `ssh` (Block, Optional) SSH configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ssh))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VM name (mirrors the `name` attribute; satisfies the Terraform ID convention).
- `ip` (String) IP address of the first replica.
- `state` (String) State of the first replica.

<a id="nestedblock--disk"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk`

Required:

- `from` (String) Resolved image URL for the boot disk.

Optional:

- `patch` (Block, Optional) File patch operations applied to the disk image before first boot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--disk--patch))
- `size` (String) Disk size with unit suffix (e.g. "20Gi", "100Gi"). Defaults to "20Gi".

<a id="nestedblock--disk--patch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk.patch`

Optional:

- `add` (Block List) Files to write into the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--disk--patch--add))
- `del` (Block List) Files to remove from the disk image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--disk--patch--del))
- `mod` (Block List) RE2-regex substitutions applied in-place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--disk--patch--mod))

<a id="nestedblock--disk--patch--add"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk.patch.add`

Required:

- `content` (String) Literal file content.
- `dst` (String) Absolute destination path inside the disk image.

Optional:

- `trigger` (String) Post-add trigger. Supported: "grub-mkconfig".


<a id="nestedblock--disk--patch--del"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk.patch.del`

Required:

- `dst` (String) Absolute path to delete.


<a id="nestedblock--disk--patch--mod"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disk.patch.mod`

Required:

- `dst` (String) Absolute path of the file to modify.
- `new` (String) Replacement text. May reference $1, ${name}.
- `old` (String) RE2 pattern to match.




<a id="nestedblock--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh`

Optional:

- `keypair_path` (String) Path to the SSH private key file; the public key is read from <keypair_path>.pub.
- `user` (String) SSH username (default "ubuntu").
